attBesluta.text: I ordered this for my husband to use with his weight training and he loves it. It is very heavy, 39lbs without any added weight to it. Super sturdy and made of quality materials. He had an easy time assembling it. This has been very effective with his training as it functions well using both indoors or outside. Slides very easily on rubber gym mats and solid surface flooring, and if you want even more resistance this does work outside on grass. Very nice addition to any home gym.

Bought this workout sled for my grandson, a high school freshman who plays football and runs track. It was delivered sooner than expected and am more than pleased with the product. Was a little concerned about how the sled would glide on grass but my grandson has been pulling it and his little sister all over the back yard (the harness works great). Very sturdy and easy to assemble. Would definitely recommend this product.

Replaced a 30 yo valve on a log splitter without a detent. It works great. Now I can work with 2 hands. Only issue is the plastic cover for the adjustment fitting that will be easily damaged.

This item was identical in every way to my other valve control; however, the input/export hydraulic ports were backwards and I had to swap hoses, which was not easy since the hoses were different lengths and the fittings also needed to be swapped. Other than that works as described.

I bought this because I needed an easy to set up screen tent to carry in the camper. I love that I can set this up by myself even though I’m older and quite short. It does require me to stand on a stool to put the bracing poles in place but it is still easier than threading poles through the tent fabric like the old fashion tents were. I would highly recommend this if you need a portable screen tent that can be used by one or two people. I do find it is small for three or more people and wish I had ordered the 12 x 12 size.

The biggest plus is it does not take up much space when stored. I can place it behind the driver's seat of my van. However, do not expect it to be the same as it was before you first opened it. It stores much wider than that. I was actually able to put it up and take it down by myself. Features are nice like the extra flaps at the bottom of the sides and especially the way to zipper opens. You can open the tent quite easily with one hand.
